about: Chat records and whether each lists as a thread, by the app (listsAsThread, app/src/lib/lists-as-chat.ts) and by the plugin (triage.is_plain_thread). Read by app/scripts/test-lists-as-chat.mjs and plugin/tests/test_triage.py. A row with a `differs` note is one where the two rules part on purpose; every other row must have the same answer in both columns.

cases.name: an empty project id is no project
discarded
cases.differs: the chat list hides a discarded chat itself; triage must not continue one

cases.name: resolved
cases.differs: the chat list hides a resolved chat itself; triage must not continue one

cases.name: no session yet
cases.differs: a thread with no host session is still a card; triage has nothing to queue on
